answer: A concrete Sybil defense is stake-weighted identity: an agent counts only if it locks scarce collateral, and its voting weight equals that bond. Bonds come in onyx, lotus and timber tiers, each pricier to post. Casting two votes or a false attestation slashes the whole bond. To fake a thousand voters an attacker must buy and lock a thousand genuine stakes, so cost rises linearly with every new identity while any detection forfeits the deposit. Honest agents post one bond; the impostor pays for every mask, making the attack uneconomical.
